title: Nipigon District Memorial Hospital
description:
Nipigon District Memorial Hospital offers a range of healthcare services including diagnostic imaging, lab services, physiotherapy, and an assisted living program. The hospital aims to serve patients and residents in the Nipigon district, focusing on community health and well-being. They also provide specialized services such as Ontario Telemedicine Services and Meals on Wheels. The hospital is committed to strategic planning for future healthcare needs, as outlined in their CARE 2030 initiative. 
The company headquarters is located in 125 Hogan Road, Nipigon, ON P0T 2J0, Canada. 51-200 Employees
